issues: generate_sdxl.py was OOM-killed at 13.9 GB (cgroup limit 14.3 GB) while loading the UNet on the first run (~10 min lost): a plain del of the encode pipeline left the text encoders held. Minimal fix on this branch: move both text encoders to meta and malloc_trim before the UNet loads; peak then about 13.5 GB (VAE decode), about 3.5 min an image.
